mapper.select: SELECT rt_score, lh_score, rp_score FROM results WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, result_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.result_id, p.axis_code, p.persona_name, p.description, p.feature, p.strength, p.caution, r.rt_score, r.lh_score, r.rp_score, p.stock_ratio, p.bond_ratio, p.deposit_ratio, r.created_at AS analyzed_at FROM results r JOIN personas p ON p.persona_id = r.persona_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.result_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT persona_id FROM personas WHERE axis_code = #{axisCode} ORDER BY persona_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO results ( user_id, persona_id, rt_score, lh_score, rp_score ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{personaId}, #{score.rtScore}, #{score.lhScore}, #{score.rpScore} )
